reviews.text: I cant say enough good things about Sam.  He has helped me so much on my fitness journey. He cares about each of his clients and is always encouraging and motivational.  I am doing things I never thought possible at my age.  I am stronger and feel amazing.  Great trainer and a great person!
reviews.author: Paula McGoldrick

reviews.text: Sam is the best trainer!! Super friendly and always motivating. He makes working out fun and always has different exercises and types of workouts planned for you in advanced of your session. I have seen a huge difference in my strength, and endurance while strictly working out with Sam. Since day 1 he has been helping me achieve my goals of fat loss and muscle gain. I have been hitting milestones with Sam and I am grateful for him to be a part of my journey. I highly recommend to train with Sam, you will learn a lot about health and fitness and also see you are capable of much more then you can imagine!!
reviews.author: Prashant Patel

reviews.text: Y'all I love having Sam as a trainer! The workouts are challenging but fun to do. He is also really good about keeping me motivated and pushing me to my best without being to aggressive.  He listens when I say I'm not comfortable with certain exercises and modifies them accordingly. Working out with Sam has really made me more comfortable with going to the gym in my own.
reviews.author: Summer Kate

reviews.text:
Training with Sam has been an absolute pleasure. He took the time to understand your goals and will cater workouts accordingly. The motivation during workouts and coaching his mind to muscle connection way have made a huge difference. It has helped in seeing better results.

If you’re lucky, some days he might workout with you. Great guy to fun to workout with too.
reviews.author: Shreyas Amin

reviews.text: Sam is an amazing trainer. He is extremely knowledgeable, takes time to know your goals, and has always gotten back to me quickly with any questions I’ve had for him. Gym starz is more than training, it is an amazing support system through your fitness journey. Over my first 3 months, Sam helped me lose 40 pounds. You won’t regret giving him a call.
reviews.author: Christian Fisher
